removed_stage2.claim: The patient presents with a 3-day history of back pain.
removed_stage2.source_sentence: Patient is a 57-year-old male who presents with a 3-day history of back pain after injuring his back while golfing.
removed_stage2.reason: Contradicted by the conversation and no evidence-based correction was possible.
removed_stage2.nearest_evidence: Patient: The pain is in my lower back, around the area of my lumbar spine, and it hasn't radiated anywhere else. I haven't had any imaging studies done yet, but I did take some Tylenol and ibuprofen, and I tried both ice and heat, but nothing really worked. I did have some trouble with my right foot, like a dropped foot, and some weakness in my right leg, but it's gotten a little better.
